_comment: Example Phase2DeferralBody. This is the HTTP 501 response shape the Wave-AE Phase 2 Worker returns for every declared endpoint. Per §0.2 it is a contract waypoint, not a stub: it carries a documented decay deadline + a constitutional-reference list + the §0.3 envelopes that were emitted before the response. The canonical phrase is 'endpoint contract declared; persistence layer due 2026-08-27 (§16 Phase-2 deferral)' — the prohibited phrase from §0.2 is intentionally not used.
